crossRefs.note: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”

people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”
translations.bsb: Abimelech also asked Abraham, “What prompted you to do such a thing?”
translations.kjv: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
translations.asv: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
